risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and quantitatively supported, but it contains substantial standard MD&A and accounting-policy boilerplate. Key risks include declining sales and same-store sales, execution risk from expansion and increased operating costs, uncertain inventory demand, and potential impairment or tax valuation adjustments. Management remains cautiously growth-oriented, citing improved margins and planned investments despite weak revenue performance.
